class.name: ChorusGenerationUsage
class.brief_description: Token counts for one completed generation.
class.description: Read-only token counts delivered with [signal GodotChorus.generation_complete]. They come from the provider's own bookkeeping, not from the requested limits or the returned text. A request capped at zero tokens runs no model and reports zero for every count. The Echo provider counts the space-delimited chunks of the text it echoes instead of model tokens.

members.member: Leading prompt tokens reused from the provider's retained cache instead of being evaluated again. Never exceeds [member prompt_tokens].
Tokens the model sampled across visible content and reasoning, including end-of-generation and stop-marker tokens that never appear in the text.
Tokens in the generation's prompt, including special tokens and tokens reused from the cache.
